📋 REQUIRED STEPS TO PLAY / INSTALL:

  1. 1. Verify Hook Status: Ensure your status badge in the top bar shows [PATCHED]. If not, click Patch Steam first.
  2. 2. Restart Steam: Steam must be restarted so the proxy DLL loads the newly generated Lua unlock plugin.
  3. 3. Trigger Steam Download: Because Steam does not show unpurchased games in your cloud list until installation begins, click below to open Steam's official installation prompt:
  4. 4. Steam Library Filter: In your Steam Library, click the filter icon next to the search bar and ensure it is NOT set to "Ready to play / Installed only" so all games are visible.
